newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint ends firmer, lira futures active.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint ends firmer, lira futures active.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed a little firmer against the dollar on Friday in what dealers called quiet trading.
The forint closed at 156.30/35 to the dollar, compared to 156.38/43 at the opening.
The forint remained stuck to the National Bank of Hungary's resistance level (bid) as it followed the dollar/mark cross.
"Trading was calm. The forint moved in a range between 156.30 and 156.40," said Inter-Europa Bank's Ervin Csengeri.
Traders said activity was slack ahead of the release of U.S. trade figures later today.
The National Bank of Hungary set its official midday dollar midrate at 159.91 forints.

On the Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE) lira futures were the most actively traded, with particularly strong activity for the 1997 September instrument amid weakening prices. German mark, yen, sterling and ECU futures closed steady to lower. The dollar and the Swiss franc finished mixed.
Currency futures turnover on the BCE amounted to 5.28 billion forints.-- Emese Bartha,Budapest newsroom 36 1 327-4040
